mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_interactions (user_id, target_type, target_id, interaction_type, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{interactionType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id as manuscript_id, m.category_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name) as tags FROM user_interactions ui JOIN videos v ON ui.target_id = v.id JOIN manuscripts m ON v.manuscript_id = m.id LEFT JOIN video_tags vt ON v.id = vt.video_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON vt.tag_id = t.id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} AND ui.target_type = 'VIDEO' AND ui.interaction_type = 'LIKE' AND ui.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY MAX(ui.created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
